cases.title: A pipe end 50 mm outside pit P8's opening is caught and moved onto the inside wall; a pipe end 150 mm outside stays a free end
cases.plan_item: UX-PIT-02 pit catch, outline plus 100 mm (daily card D02)
cases.expected: New pit P8 at 150000,-80000 (cover 19.000, three Esc). Near pipe from 160225,-79850 to 150275,-79850 (start moved from 160275 after run n28a5 so the pipe is exactly 10 m once the end is caught; the 10.05 m pipe opened a Grade mismatch question the robot cannot answer) (end 50 mm outside the 450 mm opening, inverts 18.000 / 17.950): CE says 'Pipe end moved to the inside wall of P8 (was 50 mm short of the wall).' and 'Flow: Open end -> P8', and the pipe box starts at x 150225. Far pipe from 160375,-80150 to 150375,-80150 (end 150 mm outside): no wall move, 'Flow: Open end -> Open end', the pipe box starts at x 150375. In all, three 'End is free' lines (the near pipe's east end, both ends of the far pipe).
cases.why_not_unit: The catch uses the real pit block's outline and the live CD landing in the drawing.
not_automated: The exact boundary (an end 90 mm out caught, 110 mm out not) is not driven: the drawn wall line at 100 mm would sit within a few mm of those points. Codex can do the card's 90 / 110 pair by eye if wanted.
The pit's size is not set by the robot (the Pit tab cannot be selected); it is the remembered 450 x 450 (recorded).
